verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a first-party local API with an OpenAPI-based reference at developers.anytype.io, plus official MCP tooling and CLI for automation, giving AI-native builders a documented API surface to build against (anytype-docs-2,3,45,46,47; anytype-probe-3). However, there is no evidence of formal versioned SDK packages (e.g., JS/Python client libraries) beyond the raw API/OpenAPI spec, and a probe for a standard openapi.json endpoint 404'd, suggesting the spec isn't uniformly discoverable (anytype-probe-2). Missing for 10: published language-specific SDK packages, versioned changelog for the API, and independent developer corroboration of building against it.
